source: Thanksgiving dinner, sorted. Order your turkey today.
raw:
{
  "literal": "عشاء عيد الشكر، تم ترتيبه. اطلب الديك الرومي اليوم.",
  "adaptation": "عزومتك خلصانة. اطلب الديك الرومي دلوقتي.",
  "back_translation": "Your feast is sorted. Order the turkey right now.",
  "approach": "adapted",
  "notes": "Thanksgiving is not celebrated in Egypt, so the occasion was adapted to an 'Azouma' (a large family feast), which is when Egyptians typically serve turkey."
}
literal: عشاء عيد الشكر، تم ترتيبه. اطلب الديك الرومي اليوم.
adaptation: عزومتك خلصانة. اطلب الديك الرومي دلوقتي.
back_translation: Your feast is sorted. Order the turkey right now.
notes: Thanksgiving is not celebrated in Egypt, so the occasion was adapted to an 'Azouma' (a large family feast), which is when Egyptians typically serve turkey.
